<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Noxious Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5283) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=669" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

**Prerequisites**
[Emit Defensive Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5278)

</column>

---

You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form. A creature that fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor action also becomes [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) (or sickened 2 on a critical failure).
name: Noxious Odor
